source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The public patch changes security.sandbox.content.level from8to7 only under XP_WIN and MOZ_SANDBOX. The fixed accepted source retains7 and separate macOS/Linux defaults. The primary Bugzilla page is Access Denied and its review was deferred, so the reason, intended protection and any compatibility or security outcome remain unknown. This is a source fact with zero complete-audit credit, not advice to lower sandbox levels. No runtime sandbox test ran.
title: The May2025 Windows sandbox default change is known only from public source
